sloka: ऋषिणा च पितुर् वाक्यम् कुर्वता व्रत चारिणा ।गौर् हता जानता धर्मम् कण्डुना अपि विपश्चिता ॥२-२१-३०॥
transliteration: ṛṣiṇā ca pitur vākyam kurvatā vrata cāriṇā ।gaur hatā jānatā dharmam kaṇḍunā api vipaścitā ॥2-21-30॥

translations.english: Learned sage Kandu who knew what is righteousness and a strict observant of vows, slew a cow for carrying out the command of his father.
